name: Yasunaga Suzuha
source:
Class: Year 3, Viola Class 1

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Performer Lady." She is the ace of the rhythmic gymnastics club and has a very slender body. She is very caring and as a result has many fans and is very popular with her underclassmen. Because of said caring nature, many see her as an older sister-like figure.

Her family, the Yasunaga family, is known for being a prestigious samurai and tea ceremony family that has been around since the Edo period. As such many expect Suzuha to be an old-fashioned and proper girl, but in reality she has always been the type of person who speaks without thinking. As a result, her family practically forced her to transfer to the academy in order to "correct" her behavior, or in other words, make her learn some manners. Among the Six Maidens, she is also the one with the worst grades.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
